risks_fired.evidence: The fence's confirmation ask is 'Tell me the worktree path and confirm which files copied across' — worded to confirm positive copies, not to name what was checked-and-absent versus checked-and-failed. `<repo-name>` is Claude-inferred and feeds the cp source paths, and the copy step only ever checks two hardcoded paths (root `CLAUDE.local.md`, root `observations/`) — a personal-rules file living elsewhere is structurally outside what Claude was asked to look for, so 'confirm which files copied' cannot surface its absence.
risks_fired.fix_hint: Fence-level fix (not applied — read-only judge): after the two `cp` lines, add 'If either source path does not exist, say so explicitly and name the exact path you checked — do not silently skip.' The body's existing post-fence paragraph ('Check the copy landed before you go on...') already names the right failure and recovery move but sits one section earlier than the fence, separated by a heading and a Session widget — moving it to directly after the narration sentence would tighten the adjacency the carve-out expects.

risks_fired.evidence: Fence carries 5 distinct moves (write coordinates block, self-augment ask, run the task, follow the don't-paper-over/RUN-NOTES rules, report in three lists) with no in-fence suppressor and no post-fence body sentence naming narration specifically. Held at low, not med, because this is an explicit walk-away send-off ('I'm walking away' in-fence, 'the laptop stays awake... while it runs' in body) — the student isn't reading live, so preamble narration doesn't cost top-of-response attention the way it would in a watched exchange.
risks_fired.fix_hint: Walk-away framing already defuses most of the cost of this risk; if the trainer still wants a clean transcript, lead the fence with 'No preamble — write the coordinates block first.'

Body callout immediately after the fence names the exact risk — 'RLHF will frame partial failures as partial successes, "shipped most of it, hit a snag on X."' — and gives a recovery move with student agency: 'ask the agent to list the artifacts that didn't ship and quote the verifier output verbatim where it fired. You decide whether to push.'
